run_train_controlnet_sdxl: run the ControlNet SDXL training script with pretrained model, dataset, and output directory arguments
parse_controlnet_training_args: parse command-line arguments for ControlNet SDXL training including model paths, batch size, learning rate, and dataset config
encode_sdxl_prompts: encode text prompts using dual CLIP text encoders for SDXL with pooled embeddings and optional empty prompt replacement
validate_controlnet_pipeline: run validation inference with the trained ControlNet pipeline and log generated images to tensorboard or wandb
save_controlnet_model_card: save a HuggingFace model card with example validation images and metadata to the output repository folder
